notes.title: EL PANSAS COMING TO STEAM!
notes.content:
Almost three years in the making, it's finally here on Steam!
A dream come true, a milestone met, any indie game developer hopes to see their game on here. ːsteammockingː

Even though El Pansas has been released already on other indie websites to purchase, it is time now to share this fully comic relief platform/shooter.

We can't wait for October 11th so we can fully publicly release El Pansas on the number one indie video game platform.
